paragraphs.text: Come now, ye rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming upon you.
paragraphs.original: Ἄγε νῦν οἱ πλούσιοι, κλαύσατε ὀλολύζοντες ἐπὶ ταῖς ταλαιπωρίαις ὑμῶν ταῖς ἐπερχομέναις.
paragraphs.translit: Age nyn hoi plousioi, klausate ololyzontes epi tais talaipōriais hymōn tais eperchomenais.

paragraphs.text: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are moth-eaten.
paragraphs.original: ὁ πλοῦτος ὑμῶν σέσηπεν, καὶ τὰ ἱμάτια ὑμῶν σητόβρωτα γέγονεν,
paragraphs.translit: ho ploutos hymōn sesēpen, kai ta himatia hymōn sētobrōta gegonen,

paragraphs.text: Your gold and your silver are rusted; and their rust shall be for a testimony against you, and shall eat your flesh as fire. Ye have laid up your treasure in the last days.
paragraphs.original: ὁ χρυσὸς ὑμῶν καὶ ὁ ἄργυρος κατίωται, καὶ ὁ ἰὸς αὐτῶν εἰς μαρτύριον ὑμῖν ἔσται καὶ φάγεται τὰς σάρκας ὑμῶν· ὡς πῦρ ἐθησαυρίσατε ἐν ἐσχάταις ἡμέραις.
paragraphs.translit: ho chrysos hymōn kai ho argyros katiōtai, kai ho ios autōn eis martyrion hymin estai kai phagetai tas sarkas hymōn· hōs pyr ethēsaurisate en eschatais hēmerais.

paragraphs.text: Behold, the hire of the laborers who mowed your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth out: and the cries of them that reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Sabaoth.
paragraphs.original: ἰδοὺ ὁ μισθὸς τῶν ἐργατῶν τῶν ἀμησάντων τὰς χώρας ὑμῶν ὁ ἀφυστερημένος ἀφʼ ὑμῶν κράζει, καὶ αἱ βοαὶ τῶν θερισάντων εἰς τὰ ὦτα Κυρίου Σαβαὼθ εἰσεληλύθασιν·
paragraphs.translit: idou ho misthos tōn ergatōn tōn amēsantōn tas chōras hymōn ho aphysterēmenos aphʼ hymōn krazei, kai hai boai tōn therisantōn eis ta ōta Kyriou Sabaōth eiselēlythasin·

paragraphs.text: Ye have lived delicately on the earth, and taken your pleasure; ye have nourished your hearts in a day of slaughter.
paragraphs.original: ἐτρυφήσατε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐσπαταλήσατε, ἐθρέψατε τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ σφαγῆς.
paragraphs.translit: etryphēsate epi tēs gēs kai espatalēsate, ethrepsate tas kardias hymōn en hēmera sphagēs.

paragraphs.text: Ye have condemned, ye have killed the righteous [one]; he doth not resist you.
paragraphs.original: κατεδικάσατε, ἐφονεύσατε τὸν δίκαιον. οὐκ ἀντιτάσσεται ὑμῖν;
paragraphs.translit: katedikasate, ephoneusate ton dikaion. ouk antitassetai hymin;

paragraphs.text: Be patient therefore, brethren, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receive the early and latter rain.
paragraphs.original: Μακροθυμήσατε οὖν, ἀδελφοί, ἕως τῆς παρουσίας τοῦ κυρίου. ἰδοὺ ὁ γεωργὸς ἐκδέχεται τὸν τίμιον καρπὸν τῆς γῆς, μακροθυμῶν ἐπʼ αὐτῷ ἕως λάβῃ πρόϊμον καὶ ὄψιμον.
paragraphs.translit: Makrothymēsate oun, adelphoi, heōs tēs parousias tou kyriou. idou ho geōrgos ekdechetai ton timion karpon tēs gēs, makrothymōn epʼ autō heōs labē proimon kai opsimon.

paragraphs.text: Be ye also patient; establish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord is at hand.
paragraphs.original: μακροθυμήσατε καὶ ὑμεῖς, στηρίξατε τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν, ὅτι ἡ παρουσία τοῦ κυρίου ἤγγικεν.
paragraphs.translit: makrothymēsate kai hymeis, stērixate tas kardias hymōn, hoti hē parousia tou kyriou ēngiken.

paragraphs.text: Murmur not, brethren, one against another, that ye be not judged: behold, the judge standeth before the doors.
paragraphs.original: μὴ στενάζετε, ἀδελφοί, κατʼ ἀλλήλων, ἵνα μὴ κριθῆτε· ἰδοὺ ὁ κριτὴς πρὸ τῶν θυρῶν ἕστηκεν.
paragraphs.translit: mē stenazete, adelphoi, katʼ allēlōn, hina mē krithēte· idou ho kritēs pro tōn thyrōn hestēken.

paragraphs.text: Take, brethren, for an example of suffering and of patience, the prophets who spake in the name of the Lord.
paragraphs.original: ὑπόδειγμα λάβετε, ἀδελφοί, τῆς κακοπαθίας καὶ τῆς μακροθυμίας τοὺς προφήτας, οἳ ἐλάλησαν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι κυρίου.
paragraphs.translit: hypodeigma labete, adelphoi, tēs kakopathias kai tēs makrothymias tous prophētas, hoi elalēsan en tō onomati kyriou.

paragraphs.text: Behold, we call them blessed that endured: ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord, how that the Lord is full of pity, and merciful.
paragraphs.original: ἰδοὺ μακαρίζομεν τοὺς ὑπομείναντας· τὴν ὑπομονὴν Ἰὼβ ἠκούσατε, καὶ τὸ τέλος κυρίου εἴδετε, ὅτι πολύσπλαγχνός ἐστιν ὁ κύριος καὶ οἰκτίρμων.
paragraphs.translit: idou makarizomen tous hypomeinantas· tēn hypomonēn Iōb ēkousate, kai to telos kyriou eidete, hoti polysplanchnos estin ho kyrios kai oiktirmōn.

paragraphs.text: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by the heaven, nor by the earth, nor by any other oath: but let your yea be yea, and your nay, nay; that ye fall not under judgment.
paragraphs.original: Πρὸ πάντων δέ, ἀδελφοί μου, μὴ ὀμνύετε, μήτε τὸν οὐρανὸν μήτε τὴν γῆν μήτε ἄλλον τινὰ ὅρκον· ἤτω δὲ ὑμῶν τὸ Ναὶ ναὶ καὶ τὸ Οὒ οὔ, ἵνα μὴ ὑπὸ κρίσιν πέσητε.
paragraphs.translit: Pro pantōn de, adelphoi mou, mē omnyete, mēte ton ouranon mēte tēn gēn mēte allon tina horkon· ētō de hymōn to Nai nai kai to Ou ou, hina mē hypo krisin pesēte.

paragraphs.text: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praise.
paragraphs.original: Κακοπαθεῖ τις ἐν ὑμῖν; προσευχέσθω· εὐθυμεῖ τις; ψαλλέτω.
paragraphs.translit: Kakopathei tis en hymin; proseuchesthō· euthymei tis; psalletō.

paragraphs.text: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
paragraphs.original: ἀσθενεῖ τις ἐν ὑμῖν; προσκαλεσάσθω τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους τῆς ἐκκλησίας, καὶ προσευξάσθωσαν ἐπʼ αὐτὸν ἀλείψαντες αὐτὸν ἐλαίῳ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ κυρίου·
paragraphs.translit: asthenei tis en hymin; proskalesasthō tous presbyterous tēs ekklēsias, kai proseuxasthōsan epʼ auton aleipsantes auton elaiō en tō onomati tou kyriou·

paragraphs.text: and the prayer of faith shall save him that is sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, it shall be forgiven him.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἡ εὐχὴ τῆς πίστεως σώσει τὸν κάμνοντα, καὶ ἐγερεῖ αὐτὸν ὁ κύριος· κἂν ἁμαρτίας ᾖ πεποιηκώς, ἀφεθήσεται αὐτῷ.
paragraphs.translit: kai hē euchē tēs pisteōs sōsei ton kamnonta, kai egerei auton ho kyrios· kan hamartias ē pepoiēkōs, aphethēsetai autō.

paragraphs.text: Confess therefore your sins one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The supplication of a righteous man availeth much in its working.
paragraphs.original: ἐξομολογεῖσθε οὖν ἀλλήλοις τὰς ἁμαρτίας καὶ εὔχεσθε ὑπὲρ ἀλλήλων, ὅπως ἰαθῆτε. πολὺ ἰσχύει δέησις δικαίου ἐνεργουμένη.
paragraphs.translit: exomologeisthe oun allēlois tas hamartias kai euchesthe hyper allēlōn, hopōs iathēte. poly ischyei deēsis dikaiou energoumenē.

paragraphs.text: Elijah was a man of like passions with us, and he prayed fervently that it might not rain; and it rained not on the earth for three years and six months.
paragraphs.original: Ἠλίας ἄνθρωπος ἦν ὁμοιοπαθὴς ἡμῖν, καὶ προσευχῇ προσηύξατο τοῦ μὴ βρέξαι, καὶ οὐκ ἔβρεξεν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἐνιαυτοὺς τρεῖς καὶ μῆνας ἕξ·
paragraphs.translit: Ēlias anthrōpos ēn homoiopathēs hēmin, kai proseuchē prosēuxato tou mē brexai, kai ouk ebrexen epi tēs gēs eniautous treis kai mēnas hex·

paragraphs.text: And he prayed again; and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.
paragraphs.original: καὶ πάλιν προσηύξατο, καὶ ὁ οὐρανὸς ὑετὸν ἔδωκεν καὶ ἡ γῆ ἐβλάστησεν τὸν καρπὸν αὐτῆς.
paragraphs.translit: kai palin prosēuxato, kai ho ouranos hyeton edōken kai hē gē eblastēsen ton karpon autēs.

paragraphs.text: My brethren, if any among you err from the truth, and one convert him;
paragraphs.original: Ἀδελφοί μου, ἐάν τις ἐν ὑμῖν πλανηθῇ ἀπὸ τῆς ἀληθείας καὶ ἐπιστρέψῃ τις αὐτόν,
paragraphs.translit: Adelphoi mou, ean tis en hymin planēthē apo tēs alētheias kai epistrepsē tis auton,

paragraphs.text: let him know, that he who converteth a sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall cover a multitude of sins.
paragraphs.original: γινωσκέτω ὅτι ὁ ἐπιστρέψας ἁμαρτωλὸν ἐκ πλάνης ὁδοῦ αὐτοῦ σώσει ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἐκ θανάτου καὶ καλύψει πλῆθος ἁμαρτιῶν.
paragraphs.translit: ginōsketō hoti ho epistrepsas hamartōlon ek planēs hodou autou sōsei psychēn autou ek thanatou kai kalypsei plēthos hamartiōn.
